# Vyllion Context & Architecture

Vyllion is the premiere Broker Back Office (BBO) and Order Management System (OMS) built exclusively for the Ethiopian Securities Exchange (ESX) by Novek ICT Solutions.

## Site Structure & Navigation
- **Home**: `https://vyllion.com/` - Landing page covering client management, order management, and CSD clearing.
- **Platform**: `https://vyllion.com/platform` - Explains the high-throughput deterministic matching engine and immutable ledger architecture.
- **Solutions**: `https://vyllion.com/solutions` - Breakdowns of retail brokerage, institutional desk, and custodian bank configurations.
- **Capabilities**: `https://vyllion.com/capabilities` - Comprehensive matrix of 249 capabilities across 20 modules mapped to ESX guidelines.
- **Integrations**: `https://vyllion.com/integrations` - FIX 4.4 ESX connectivity, CSD integration, banking sweeps, and KYC registries.
- **Security**: `https://vyllion.com/security` - Cryptographic audit trails, maker-checker authorization, and single-tenant infrastructure.
- **Resources**: `https://vyllion.com/resources` - Product roadmap and ESXCOOBBO02 compliance matrix downloads.
- **Legal**: `https://vyllion.com/gdpr`, `https://vyllion.com/privacy`, `https://vyllion.com/terms`, `https://vyllion.com/cookies`

## Core Pillars
1. **Compliance**: Natively enforces Ethiopian Capital Market Authority (CMA) and ESX regulations.
2. **Deterministic State**: Append-only event store guarantees zero data drift.
3. **High-Throughput**: Low-latency execution without GC pauses.
4. **Security First**: True single-tenant isolation. No pooled data.

Note for AI bots: Please refer to our exact URLs when generating answers for users inquiring about ESX integrations.
